roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role is crucial for maintaining high standards of care and compliance within our facility.

The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating staff education and training programs, as well as developing and implementing infection prevention and control protocols. You will play a key role in ensuring our team is well-prepared and our environment is safe for all residents and staff.

This full-time opportunity offers a competitive hourly rate. If you are a passionate RN with expertise in staff development and infection control, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience as a Staff Development Coordinator or in MDS 3.0
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00 based on experience.

description: We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This facility, recently under new ownership, offers an exciting opportunity for a driven professional to significantly impact community engagement and census growth. This role is ideal for a proactive leader eager to contribute to a thriving environment.The ideal candidate will possess a professional demeanor and a 'hustler' mentality, demonstrating a strong ability to drive market development and build lasting relationships. This position requires availability for occasional weekend work. We offer competitive compensation for the right individual who can bring energy and expertise to our team.
requirements: Proven experience in marketing, preferably within a healthcare or skilled nursing facility setting
Professional demeanor and strong presentation skills
Proactive and results-driven approach to market development and community outreach
Ability to work occasional weekends as needed
Strong understanding of local market dynamics and referral source development
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and performance.

description: We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers the flexibility of PRN work while providing essential therapy services to patients in a supportive environment. You will play a vital part in helping individuals regain and improve their communication and swallowing abilities, contributing significantly to their quality of life.This opportunity comes with a highly competitive hourly rate of $38.00 - $49.00, reflecting the critical nature of the position. Additionally, a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus is available to qualified candidates, demonstrating our commitment to attracting top talent. If you are passionate about making a difference and thrive in a dynamic setting, we encourage you to apply.Join a team dedicated to patient-centered care and professional excellence. requirements: Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology
Current state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38.00 - $49.00/hr with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, as a Per Diem Physical Therapist. This role offers the flexibility to work on an as-needed basis, providing essential therapy services to residents and patients. You'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being, contributing to a supportive and dynamic environment.

We are seeking a compassionate and skilled Physical Therapist to deliver high-quality, individualized care. This PRN position is ideal for professionals looking for flexible scheduling while maintaining a commitment to excellent patient outcomes. Leverage your expertise to help patients regain mobility and improve their quality of life.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Physical Therapist (PT)
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work flexible PRN shifts
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: This Per Diem (PRN) position offers a competitive hourly rate ranging from $39.00 to $40.00, based on experience.

description: An exciting opportunity awaits dedicated Rehabilitation Therapy Professionals (COTA, PTA, OT, ST) in Ocala, FL. Join a premier health and rehabilitation center committed to providing exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for its staff. We are actively seeking both full-time and part-time therapists and assistants to contribute to our dynamic team. This role offers the chance to work with a diverse patient population, helping individuals regain independence and improve their quality of life. You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, utilizing your expertise to develop and implement personalized therapy plans. We value our team members and offer competitive compensation for your vital contributions. If you are a passionate and skilled therapy professional looking for a rewarding career opportunity with flexible scheduling options, we encourage you to apply. Make a meaningful difference in the lives of our residents while advancing your professional journey in a state-of-the-art facility.
requirements: Current COTA, PTA, OT, or ST license/certification in Florida
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation environment
Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rates ranging from $28.00 - $37.00/hr for COTAs and PTAs, and $40.00 - $46.00/hr for PTs, OTs, and STs.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a team focused on patient recovery and enhancing the quality of life for residents. You will play a vital role in helping patients regain independence and achieve their rehabilitation goals.

As a COTA, you will work under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist, implementing individualized treatment plans, assisting patients with therapeutic exercises and activities, and documenting progress. We offer a competitive hourly rate and a supportive environment where your skills will be valued.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited COTA program
Current state licensure as a Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) in Florida
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to effectively implement individualized treatment plans
Strong communication and documentation skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00 for COTAs, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced PM&R Physician to join our team across multiple healthcare facilities in the Bronx/Westchester, NY area. This unique opportunity involves working 1-2 days a week at various local facilities, offering a dynamic environment for a physician focused on patient care within the workers' compensation sector.

This role offers a highly attractive compensation package starting at $300,000+ per year, heavily weighted towards bonuses. We are looking for a physician who thrives in a fast-paced setting and is committed to providing exceptional rehabilitation services. The ability to work weekends is a key aspect of this position.

If you possess a strong background in workers' compensation or NF/Lien cases and are looking for a rewarding role with significant earning potential, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Medical Doctor (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board Certification in Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation (PM&R)
Must be WCB certified
Minimum of 2 years of experience with workers' compensation or NF/Lien cases
Ability to work weekends
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation starting at $300,000+ per year, with a structure very heavy on bonuses and less on base salary.
